_doc: Stomp styles (docs/decisions/0062-stomp-styles.md, StompLook): how a stomp on an enemy wisp looks. Every style keeps the stomp's timing (Life.R stomp_time, stomp_cycle); only the body changes. A style lists what it changes from 'base'. A Hunter with its own stomp clip (content/rules/warden_anim/<art>.json states.stomp) stomps with that clip; 'hunter' gives a rig without one its own style. A style with 'cost' is bought with gems and worn in the 'stomp' slot (Save.d.look.stomp, bought ones in Save.d.stomps); worn, it plays on the rig in place of the clip. foot: r | l | both (a two-footed jump) | alt (right, then left). lift and knee: hip and knee angles in radians at the top of the lift. hop: metres the body rises before the slam. lean: forward tilt in radians. twist: shoulder turn in radians at the top. crouch: 0..1 how low the standing leg sits. arms: out (left arm out for balance) | wide (both out) | up (both fists overhead, down with the slam) | fists (both fists hammer the ground) | hips (hands on hips).

thunder_stomp.name: Thunder Stomp
thunder_stomp.desc: A twisting leap and both feet down like a dropped anvil.
